title: TypeScript optional properties and optional parameters keep their TypeScript meaning and are not rewritten into Optional<T>
notes: specification/type-system.mdx, 'Optional': 'Optional properties and parameters MUST keep their TypeScript meaning.' docs/DECISIONS.md 'Optionals and nullability' (Locked): 'Existing TypeScript undefined, optional parameters, and optional properties remain supported for TypeScript compatibility.' An implementation that lifted `nickname?: string` into Optional<string> would make `entry.nickname === undefined` ill-typed and change the printed output.
